variants.headline: Still in view: full shelves, empty household purses
variants.sub: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it.
variants.body:
Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Our principles should be intelligible beside a full shelf that a hungry person cannot afford. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: food for sale beyond the buyer's means
variants.sub: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals.
variants.body:
Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it. This story remains under examination, with renewed attention to the responsibilities raised by the original report.

Our principles should be intelligible beside a full shelf that a hungry person cannot afford. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
